notes: Fix for the critic fault: T2 Lantern moves from z -575 to -540. Its platform now runs z -555 to -525. By hand, the r100 fillet at (-334,-600) turns 11.3°, so its tangent ends near z -590. The checker found the old platform partly on that curve, so I left at least 35 m of margin. Rocket moves from z -265 to -230 (platform -245 to -215) to keep the gap at 300 m or more.
My last answer said all T2 platforms were on straight track. That was wrong for Lantern. I worked it out by hand and the checker was never run.

New T2 gaps along the track, by hand (each r50 corner counted as a 78.5 m arc): parade–harbourside 320, harbourside–docks 310, docks–comet ~460, comet–lantern ~462 (246 + 78.5 + 16 + 61 + 60), lantern–rocket 310, rocket–terraces 430. All are inside 300–500.

Reach after the move: lantern-west (-260,-563) is about 78 m from Lantern and rocket-west (-260,-296) about 99 m from Rocket. lamplight-west is 148 m from S1 Sphere Gardens. Reach for the other plots is unchanged from last round, all under 250.

Platforms are still on straight track at the other corners. Docks (-615 to -585) ends before the corner tangent at z -676. Comet (x -65 to -35) sits between the T1 crossing and the tangent at x -296. Terraces (185 to 215) ends before the Crown Road tangent at z 236.
Interchanges are unchanged: T2/parade ↔ S1/harbour 34 m, T2/comet ↔ T1/comet 63 m, T1/circus ↔ S1/circus. The network is one connected whole.

The plan checker (bun tools/plan/cli.ts) has NOT been run because I have no shell. Latch or Aster must run it and confirm T-S1, T-S2 and N-R1 before acceptance. Still open for Aster: notes/why contradicts notes/concept. Also, Datum's ask puts S1 Harbour at (340,0), but the station is at (290,0).
